notes: NO_ELIGIBLE_REASON: confirmed against page-001.png: a two-column narrative page of Notes to Financial Statements with no ruled table anywhere, so the six grid rows for this page are sentence fragments the grid mistook for a table and carry no column meaning. Every printed figure fails the category test: the 82,010 PDP participants are a headcount with no category under any allowed family; the $16,239,000 and $14,701,000 IBNR amounts are a health-insurance claims reserve inside benefits payable, which is a non-investment operating line this document type excludes; and the $480,771,000 is an investment proceeds receivable, which is neither investments at fair value nor a distribution. NO_ELIGIBLE_DATA rather than REFERENCE_ONLY because the page does print substantive amounts, all of them out of category. No document_context row is added: the record contract permits a no-data document a header-only record file, and a page whose only row is the context row is rejected by validate-final.
